battle.name: 可洛峐山之戰
battle.brief: 公元552年，東羅馬將軍納爾塞斯率聯軍南下，在維蘇威火山東麓的可洛峐山追上東哥特王蒂亞的遠征軍。羅軍在狹窄隘口以步兵纏鬥，待哥特陣線展開，主力騎兵由側翼俯衝，擊潰其陣營，蒂亞陣亡。卡面的羅馬重步兵屬共和至早期帝國型制，本役上陣者为其晚期繼承者：持橢圓大盾、披鱗甲的野戰步兵。

kit.name: 羅馬重步兵
kit.history: 分段鎧甲配重盾。羅馬的戰力靠的是補充兵源與補給線，不是靠重裝。

countries: 公元六世紀上半葉，東羅馬（拜占庭）帝國與義大利的東哥特王國在西西里海與亞平寧半島之間打了整整二十年。開戰前，東西兩半以五十年和約劃界：東哥特王國承認查士丁尼為唯一皇帝，割讓達爾馬提亞與部分海岸，羅馬則承認狄奧多里克一世的兒子阿拉達斯為意大島之主。和約被撕毀後，帝國以「東哥特人干預達爾馬提亞的抗稅、庇護被廢黜的君主」為由，於五三五年派貝利薩留渡海入義大利，一年之內連取拿坡里、拉文納與羅馬；東哥特一方在托提拉五三八年奪回羅馬之後重新集結，改以游擊破壞城邑與糧道。換上納爾塞斯作前線主將後，羅馬的指揮系統是：皇帝查士丁尼一世在君士坦丁堡掌握戰略與經費，樞密院執政官納爾塞斯在戰場直接指揮，兵種由帝國常備兵、限期服役兵與盟邦傭兵混編，步兵歸各營指揮官，騎兵是羅馬騎兵、赫魯利人、格皮德人與阿拉伯輕騎合編的軍團。哥特方面的最高統帥是國王蒂亞，旗下是烏爾布魯斯人等部族的戰士、哥特貴族自帶的私兵、數量有限的東哥特重裝步兵與游騎兵，另有被裹挾的義大利農兵與工匠隨軍。羅馬一方還有西西里與阿非利加運來的穀物、海軍船隊與工程兵支援；哥特一方只能就地徵發，這一點正是托提拉與蒂亞兩代人都解不開的難題。
countriesEn: For the first half of the sixth century the Eastern Roman, or Byzantine, Empire and the Ostrogothic kingdom in Italy fought one another for twenty years across the Sicilian Sea and the Apennine peninsula. Before the war the two halves of the Roman world had drawn their frontier with a fifty-year treaty: the Ostrogothic kingdom recognised Justinian as the only emperor and ceded Dalmatia and stretches of coast, while Rome recognised Athaladas, son of Theodoric the Great, as lord of Italy. After the treaty was torn up, the Empire went to war in 535 on the pretext that the Goths had interfered with the tax revolt in Dalmatia and had sheltered a deposed king, sending Belisarius across the sea in that year; within a year he had taken Naples, Ravenna and Rome. The Ostrogoths, after Totila retook Rome in 538, regrouped and switched to harassing towns and cutting supply lines. When Narses took over as commander in the field, the Roman chain of command ran as follows: Emperor Justinian I in Constantinople controlled strategy and money, the magister officiorum Narses commanded on the spot, and the troops were a mixture of regulars, limited-service levies and federate mercenaries, the infantry under their own battalion officers, the cavalry a mixed command of Roman horse, Heruli, Gepids and Arab light riders. On the Gothic side the supreme commander was the king Teia; under him fought warriors of tribes such as the Urbiccii, the private retainers of the Gothic nobility, a limited body of Ostrogothic heavy infantry and of mounted skirmishers, together with Italian peasants and craftsmen swept up into the column. The Romans further drew on grain shipped from Sicily and Africa, on a fleet and on engineer corps; the Goths could only live off the country, and that was precisely the problem neither Totila nor Teia ever solved.
people: 這場戰役的主角是東羅馬將軍納爾塞斯。他出身軍戶家庭，早年在西部帝國的將領麾下已以能戰著稱，後來在查士丁尼一世手下出任樞密院執政官，長期經手帝國的實際軍務。他年事已高且腿腳不便，後世記載說他常坐在小馬背上的轎子裡行軍，把親赴野外視為凶險之事，但正是他指揮了五五二年的最終會戰。皇帝查士丁尼一世在君士坦丁堡掌握戰略決策與經費開支，卻把前線交給納爾塞斯，並在關鍵時刻批准他放棄原定的分兵計畫，集中兵力直取王都方向。東哥特末代王蒂亞在五五二年塔吉奈之戰後即位，是戴奧德里克王朝最後一位國王，陣亡時年紀尚輕；其麾下有在伏擊中被俘後遭殺的部族首領阿爾莫德，以及在潰退中被羅馬騎兵追殺的哥特貴族。史家普羅科匹烏斯是這場戰爭最關鍵的記錄者，他長期隨軍駐在義大利，《戰爭史》第六卷留下的會戰過程是後世重建此役的主要依據；阿加提亞斯則記錄了戰爭收尾的幾年。普羅科匹烏斯把納爾塞斯寫成身材矮小、其貌不揚而精於算計的人，與他筆下另一名名將貝利薩留形成鮮明對照。
peopleEn: The central figure of this campaign is the Roman general Narses. The son of a military family, he had already made a name as a fighter under the generals of the western empire and later became magister officiorum under Justinian I, handling the empire's real military affairs for years. He was old and lame, and later accounts have him riding in a litter on a small horse and treating a campaign in the open field as a dangerous business, yet it was he who commanded the decisive engagement of 552. Emperor Justinian I in Constantinople kept the strategic decisions and the money but left the front to Narses, and at the crucial moment approved his dropping the planned division of the army in favour of concentrating everything on the line towards the royal capital. The last Ostrogothic king, Teia, was crowned after the battle of Taginae in 552 and was the final ruler of the Theodoric line; he was still young when he fell. Among his men were tribal chiefs such as Almod, captured in an ambush and then killed, and Gothic nobles cut down in the rout. The most important witness to the whole war is the historian Procopius of Caesarea, who stayed with the Roman army in Italy for years; the course of the engagement in the sixth book of his Wars is the principal basis for reconstructing this battle. Agathias records the closing years of the settlement. Procopius paints Narses as a man of small stature, plain in appearance and a master of patient calculation, a deliberate contrast with the other great general of the war, Belisarius.
kits: 卡面的羅馬重步兵是共和國晚期至早期帝國的典型裝備：分段鎧甲配大而厚的橢圓盾，雙手持短劍，肩後插兩支標槍，近身以劍搏鬥、齊射靠標槍解決。必須說明的是，這種重裝軍團步兵到五五二年早已退場：三世紀末到四世紀的軍制改革把大盾重裝步兵改為小型、輕裝、以投射武器為主的野戰部隊，傳統的軍團番號在戴克里先與查士丁尼時代早被廢除。所以本役真正上陣的，是這套血統的晚期繼承者：羅馬禁衛與野戰步兵手持橢圓或微彎的長盾，披鱗甲或鎖子甲，用短劍與長矛作戰，輔以輕型標槍；赫魯利、格皮德等傭兵步兵則用小圓盾、長矛與雙刃斧，鎧甲較少，靠體力與速度衝撞。哥特軍隊在托提拉時代已大量裝備羅馬造的大盾與長矛並使用雙刃劍，東哥特重裝步兵的樣式與晚期羅馬野戰兵幾乎相同，雙方在裝備上的差距因此不像一般印象中那樣懸殊。羅馬方面的獨特優勢在投射火力與攻城器械：扭力式弩砲與配重式投石機配給工程兵，圍城戰中用來對付城牆與城內建築；本次會戰前的義大利戰線上，圍拿坡里、圍羅馬都曾投入這類器械。糧秣方面，羅軍靠西西里與阿非利加的穀物經海運至拿坡里等港口再轉陸路，馬匹補充依賴南部平原；哥特軍隊只能就地徵發，這正是托提拉與蒂亞兩代人都無法解決的弱點。
kitsEn: The Roman heavy infantry on the card is the classic type of the late Republic and early Empire: segmented armour with a large thick oval shield, a short sword in both hands, and two javelins carried over the shoulder, with the sword for close fighting and the javelins for the massed volley. It must be said plainly that this heavy legionary infantry had been gone for centuries by 552: the military reforms of the late third and fourth centuries replaced the large-shield heavy infantry with smaller, lighter field troops whose main weapons were missiles, and the old legionary numbering had already been abolished under Diocletian and Justinian. What actually fought at Mons Lactarius were the late successors of that line: Roman scholae and field infantry carrying oval or slightly curved shields, wearing scale or mail, fighting with short swords and long spears and supported by light javelins; Herulian and Gepid mercenary infantry carried small round shields, long spears and double axes with little armour, relying on physical power and speed. The Gothic army, from Totila's time onward, was largely equipped with Roman-made large shields and spears and used the double-edged sword, so Ostrogothic heavy infantry looked almost identical to late Roman field soldiers and the gap in equipment between the two sides was far smaller than popular impression suggests. Rome's real edge lay in missile fire and siege engineering: torsion ballistae and counterweight stone-throwers were manned by engineer troops and used against walls and buildings, and the Italian front before this battle had seen them deployed in the sieges of Naples and of Rome. On logistics the Romans drew grain from Sicily and Africa, landed it at ports such as Naples and moved it inland, while horses were replenished from the southern plains; the Goths could only requisition locally, and that was the weakness neither Totila nor Teia could solve.
tactics: 納爾塞斯的戰役構想是一路壓迫：先以游騎與輕裝步兵在前偵察哥特人的退路，羅軍主力則沿亞平寧山東麓或拉丁大道南下，盡量沿海岸行軍，就地取食，避免與哥特騎兵在開闊地糾纏。哥特人退到維蘇威火山東麓的可洛峐山時，看中了那裡的地形：山嶺逼近海岸，道路狹窄，一側是山坳，一側是可展開的平地，哥特軍封住隘口，把追兵限制在狹窄路段。會戰展開，羅軍先以弓箭手與輕裝步兵在正面施加壓力，誘使哥特前線隊形鬆散、陣線向兩側伸長；待哥特軍在隘口外的平地上展開，納爾塞斯立刻把預先集中的騎兵用在決定性的一點上：羅馬騎兵自側面較高的位置衝下，居高臨下撞擊哥特陣線的側翼，同時步兵正面咬住不放，把哥特步兵擠壓在狹窄地面上無法展開。哥特陣線在騎兵衝擊下斷裂，蒂亞率親兵力圖逆轉戰局，卻被羅馬騎兵包圍衝散；赫魯利步兵趁隙壓上，潰兵一路退向拿坡里城門，羅軍追到城門下，哥特人靠關閉城門才止住追擊，會戰在一天之內決定。事後清點戰場時，蒂亞的屍體被找到，靠頸上的金環和鎧甲上的寶石確認身分，隨即被斬首送往君士坦丁堡。
tacticsEn: Narses's plan for the campaign was relentless pressure. Light cavalry and light infantry were sent ahead to scout the route the Goths would take, while the main body of the Roman army moved south along the eastern foothills of the Apennines or the Via Latina, keeping near the coast so that it could live off the country and avoiding any prolonged cavalry action with the Goths in open ground. When the Goths withdrew to Mons Lactarius on the eastern slopes of Vesuvius they chose the ground for a reason: the mountain closes on the sea, the road is narrow, there is a defile on one side and a stretch of level ground on the other, and the Gothic army blocked the pass, squeezing the pursuers into a narrow lane. When the action began, the Romans first pressed with archers and light infantry on the front, teasing the Gothic line into slack order and stretching it out to either side. Once the Goths had deployed into the open beyond the defile, Narses at once committed the cavalry he had massed to the one decisive point: the Roman horse came down from the higher ground on the flank, striking the side of the Gothic line from above, while the infantry held the front and pinned the Gothic foot squeezed together on ground too narrow to deploy. The Gothic line broke under the charge, and Teia tried to reverse the battle with his personal guard, only to be enveloped and scattered by the Roman horse; Herulian infantry pressed in at the gap, the rout ran back to the gates of Naples, and the Romans pursued to the gate, where the Goths only stopped the pursuit by shutting the doors. The battle was decided within a single day. When the field was searched afterwards, the body of Teia was found and identified by the golden collar on his neck and the jewels on his armour, and the head was cut off and carried to Constantinople.
data: 關於數字，史料本身相當節省。普羅科匹烏斯記載納爾塞斯麾下有步兵約八千、騎兵約一萬八千，合計約二萬二千人；現代史家多認為這個騎兵數字為戰記誇大，實際可投入野戰的兵力當在萬餘人上下。蒂亞一方的哥特軍沒有留下可信數目，一般認為是由托提拉時代殘部與各地集結的數千至萬餘人。會戰時間，通行說法是五五二年，另有編年把會戰記在五五三年，因為普羅科匹烏斯只寫年份不寫月日；本卡目錄把此役編在五八二年，與主流編年不合，應屬編目誤差，敘事則以五五二年為準。行軍方面，納爾塞斯於五五二年自羅馬出發，據記載沿海岸走了約三百公里的路線，行程約兩至三個月；羅馬至會戰地直線約二百二十公里，因沿海山脈切割而彎曲拉長。戰損方面，普羅科匹烏斯沒有記下兩軍的精確死傷，只說哥特軍全軍覆沒、蒂亞陣亡，羅軍亦有損失但不大，隨即進軍拿坡里。整場戰爭的總量更值得記錄：從五三五年到五五四年或五六二年，拜占庭先後投入義大利的部隊、攻城器械與船隻在數萬人層級，戰線遍及半島南北，並遇上五三七年羅馬陷落、五三八年托提拉奪回羅馬、五四六年托提拉再奪羅馬等反覆。二十年戰爭加上五四一年與五四二年兩次瘟疫，使義大利城邑人口大幅下降、耕地荒廢，六世紀中葉的義大利已不宜再用富庶行省來形容。
dataEn: On numbers the sources are stingy. Procopius gives Narses about eight thousand foot and eighteen thousand horse, roughly twenty-two thousand men in all; most modern historians regard the cavalry figure as an exaggeration of the battle narrative, and the strength actually available for field action was probably in the region of ten thousand or a little over. The Gothic army under Teia left no reliable figure, and is generally taken to have been a few thousand up to some ten thousand, drawn from the remnants of Totila's army and from tribal muster. As for the date, the received year is 552, though some chronicles place the engagement in 553, since Procopius writes the year but not the month or day; this card's catalogue files the battle under 582, which does not agree with the mainstream chronologies and is best treated as a cataloguing error, the narrative following 552. On the march, Narses set out from Rome in 552 and, according to the account, covered some three hundred kilometres of coastal road in a journey of about two to three months; the straight line from Rome to the battlefield is about two hundred and twenty kilometres, lengthened by the folds of the coastal mountains. As for losses, Procopius records no exact casualty figures for either side, saying only that the Gothic army was wiped out, that Teia fell, and that the Romans lost a few men but advanced at once to take Naples. The scale of the war as a whole deserves the emphasis: between 535 and 554 or 562 the Byzantines committed troops, siege engines and shipping to Italy on a scale of tens of thousands, along front lines running the length of the peninsula, and the campaign went through the fall of Rome in 537, Totila's recapture of the city in 538, and his second recapture in 546. Twenty years of war, followed by the plagues of 541 and 542, cut the population of the Italian cities and left fields untilled; the Italy of the mid sixth century can no longer be described as a wealthy province.
cause: 打起上來的直接原因，是查士丁尼一世不接受意大利維持現狀。五三二年，他以赦免內戰、減免稅負、允許東哥特人進入君士坦丁堡任職為條件，與東哥特王國簽訂五十年和約，承認狄奧多里克系的統治只限於義大利。此後帝國以「東哥特人支持達爾馬提亞抗稅、庇護被廢黜的君主」為由撕毀和約，並利用東哥特內部的王位更替作為介入的藉口。遠因更深：自戴克里先分割帝國以來，東西兩半在稅收、軍籍與邊境貿易上長期互相猜忌；東哥特王國名義上從未脫離皇帝，卻在帝國朝廷的主戰派眼中只是必須收復的失地。哥特人一方的訴求其實相對保守：他們要求恢復和約、減少貢賦、讓兄長阿拉達斯被殺一事得到交代，並在五四〇年派出使者赴君士坦丁堡求和，但查士丁尼不肯罷手，反而加緊在西西里集結船隊。於是一場本可避免的全面戰爭被推成常態：五三五年貝利薩留率五千人渡海，一年多就奪下義大利大部分城邑，把原本只需一次外交解決的問題變成持久戰。戰爭的另一半動因在戰爭之中：五三八年托提拉奪回羅馬後，東哥特人一度以游擊與外交並用，把戰局拉成拉鋸，雙方都有過求和的時刻，但首領們都不願承擔接受對方條件的政治代價，戰爭於是只能打到一方王統崩潰為止。
causeEn: The immediate reason for the war was that Justinian I would not accept Italy remaining as it was. In 532 he concluded a fifty-year treaty with the Ostrogothic kingdom on terms of pardoning past enmities, reducing the tribute and allowing Goths to hold office at Constantinople, and he recognised the rule of Theodoric's line as confined to Italy. The Empire then tore up that treaty on the pretext that the Ostrogoths had backed the tax revolt in Dalmatia and had sheltered a deposed ruler, and it used the succession troubles inside the Gothic kingdom as the pretext for interference. The deeper causes go further back: since Diocletian divided the empire, the two halves had lived with mutual suspicion over taxes, military registers and frontier trade; the Ostrogothic kingdom had never formally left the emperor, yet to the war party at Constantinople it was nothing but an occupied province waiting to be recovered. The Goths' own demands were in fact comparatively moderate: they wanted the treaty restored, the tribute reduced, an answer for the killing of their king Athaladas, and in 540 they sent envoys to Constantinople to negotiate peace. Justinian refused to let go and instead pressed on with the gathering of shipping in Sicily. A general war that one diplomatic settlement might have avoided was thus normalised: in 535 Belisarius crossed with five thousand men and within a year and a half took most of the cities of Italy, turning a problem that diplomacy could have closed into a long war. The other half of the cause lies inside the war itself: after Totila retook Rome in 538 the Goths alternated between guerrilla war and negotiation, stretching the conflict into a seesaw, and there were moments when both sides could have made peace, but no leader would bear the political cost of accepting the other's terms, and so the war could only end when one royal line was destroyed.
impact: 這場戰役的直接後果，是東哥特王國的滅亡。蒂亞死後，義大利本土的哥特抵抗在一兩年內瓦解：仍據守康普薩半島與部分山寨的哥特人，後來被圍困到糧盡，經過協商分批投降，一部分被編入羅馬軍隊，一部分淪為奴隸，一部分逃往威尼斯等濱海據點。義大利重新回到拜占庭的版圖，直到五六八年倫巴德人入侵之前，半島有將近十五年的相對安定期。代價卻極為沉重：二十年戰爭、五四一年與五四二年兩次瘟疫、戰役與圍城的破壞，使義大利的城市人口、灌溉系統與手工業全面衰退，希臘語在政府與軍隊中取代拉丁語成為官方語言，西部帝國的傳統知識階層大幅縮減。從更長的時間看，帝國以恢復羅馬為名重奪義大利，等於在西歐留下一個軍事上虛弱的行省，而五六八年倫巴德人趁虛而入，義大利隨後分裂為倫巴德王國與拜占庭各邦，古典時代的政體在西部再無恢復的機會。軍事史上，這場會戰也常被視為古典時代最後幾場大型野戰之一：它展示了在丘陵與隘口地形下如何用正面纏鬥牽制敵軍，再以集中騎兵打擊展開陣線的側翼，這套經驗後來被中世紀的軍事著述與拜占庭的戰爭史大量引用。普羅科匹烏斯的《戰爭史》本身成為羅馬—拜占庭世界最重要的一部戰爭記錄，日後被當作兵法教材與政治宣傳的樣本。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of this battle was the end of the Ostrogothic kingdom. After the death of Teia the Gothic resistance in the Italian mainland collapsed within a year or two: the Goths still holding the Compsa peninsula and a number of strongholds were besieged until their food ran out and surrendered in negotiated instalments, some being enrolled in Roman units, some falling into slavery and some escaping to coastal refuges such as Venice. Italy returned to the Byzantine empire, and for nearly fifteen years before the Lombards came over the Alps in 568 the peninsula enjoyed a period of relative quiet. The cost was appalling: twenty years of war, the plagues of 541 and 542, and the destruction wrought by battles and sieges drained the cities of Italy of population, broke down their irrigation systems and ruined their crafts, while Greek replaced Latin as the language of government and of the army and the traditional literate class of the western empire shrank sharply. On a longer view, the Empire's recovery of Italy in the name of restoring Rome left a militarily hollow province in the West, and the Lombards took advantage of it in 568; Italy was thereafter divided between the Lombard kingdom and the Byzantine enclaves, and the institutions of the classical age had no further chance of revival in the West. In military history the battle is often treated as one of the last large field engagements of antiquity: it shows how a frontal holding action can pin an enemy in broken ground and how concentrated cavalry can strike the flank of a deployed line, and that lesson was widely drawn by later Byzantine military writing and by medieval authors. Procopius's Wars itself became the most important battle narrative of the Roman-Byzantine world, read both as a manual of war and as a model of political propaganda.
result: 結論很簡單：羅馬軍勝。蒂亞本人陣亡，東哥特聯軍在可洛峐山被擊潰，蒂亞的頭顱被送回君士坦丁堡，東哥特王國至此在法理上與實力上都不復存在。納爾塞斯隨即率軍進入拿坡里，接收城內的糧秣與船隻，然後沿西海岸推進，掃清殘餘哥特據點；托提拉與蒂亞兩代留下的游擊與據點抵抗又拖了數年才被清剿完畢，最後一批哥特守軍在五五五年前後至五六二年之間分批投降，戰爭以拜占庭的全面勝利告終。義大利改由拜占庭的意大利總督府管轄，行政、稅收與教會體系重新編排，羅馬城在五五四年重新成為帝國在西部的大本營。納爾塞斯因此獲得帝國最高的榮譽，在五五四年之後進樞密院並兩度出任執政官，五六八年之後隱居羅馬的莊園，卻在五七三年被查士丁尼二世派來的人刺殺，結束了這位老將的一生。他留下的還有另一層意義：這場勝利證明查士丁尼時代的拜占庭帝國仍具備遠征與野戰能力，但同一場戰爭也把帝國的財政與人力推到極限，直接埋下了五六八年應付倫巴德入侵時無力支撐的伏線。
resultEn: The conclusion is simple: the Roman army won. Teia himself fell, the Ostrogothic coalition was broken at Mons Lactarius, and Teia's head was carried back to Constantinople; the Ostrogothic kingdom ceased to exist either in law or in fact. Narses at once entered Naples, took over the grain and shipping inside the city, and then pushed along the western coast clearing the remaining Gothic strongholds. The harassment and the fortified resistance left behind by Totila and Teia dragged on for several more years before they could be mopped up, and the last Gothic garrisons capitulated in instalments between about 555 and 562, so that the war ended in complete Byzantine victory. Italy was placed under the jurisdiction of the praetorian prefecture of Italy; the administration, the taxation and the church organisation were rearranged, and Rome became once more the great base of the empire in the West in 554. Narses received the highest honours the empire could bestow, entered the praetorian prefect's office after 554 and served twice as consul, and after 568 retired to his estate near Rome, only to be killed in 573 by men sent by Justinian II, which ended the old general's life. His legacy carries a second meaning as well: this victory demonstrated that the Byzantine empire of Justinian still had the capacity for distant campaigns and field battle, but the same war pushed the empire's finances and manpower to the limit and directly laid the groundwork for its inability to meet the Lombard invasion of 568.
